command.description: The mptcpize command sub-action (run, enable, disable). For service definitions, 'run' is the operational mode.

program.description: The path to the target program binary to be executed with MPTCP support.

program_args.description: List of command-line arguments to pass to the target program.

debug.description: If true, enables debug mode which dumps messages to stderr when TCP sockets are forced to use MPTCP.
